entities.summary: Ignatius Mouradgea d'Ohsson was an Armenian orientalist, historian and diplomat in Swedish service. In 1768 he was supreme interpreter, in its subsequent elevation to the Swedish nobility, he participated in the French-sounding names d'Ohsson. Abraham Constantin Mouradgea d'Ohsson, author of a famous History of the Mongols, was his son. He lived many years in France.
